verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort, matching the 6–6.5 anchor because its clear phase grouping and orderly core flow are offset by very small text, long peripheral feedback routes, and detail-heavy notes.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and chips have ample surrounding space, but the oversized canvas makes many labels and node texts too small for effortless arm's-length reading.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: The four numbered regions clearly separate intake, concurrent review, publishing, and lifecycle controls, while the five vertically aligned reviewer icons read immediately as a parallel group.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Core gray flows are clean and directional, but the red restart loop and blue threshold-feedback route make very long perimeter detours that require substantial eye travel and backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The main left-to-right flow, parallel review fan-out, verification path, and recovery routes are discernible, though long yellow notes and the sprawling lifecycle area weaken visual prioritization.
